company.name: Turneo
company.shortDescription: Turneo is a B2B platform that enables travel brands to offer and manage in-destination experiences for their guests.
company.description: Turneo is a traveltech company that provides an experience booking platform for hotels and resorts. It allows guests to browse and book all of their holiday activities, directly via hotel or resort website. At the same time, staff are able to see and manage experience bookings seamlessly, with Turneo's intuitive Agent Tool, while hotel managers are equipped with the tools they need to understand, build, and grow their experience offer. With no complex integration and zero setup fee, hotels can start growing their experience offer in less than a week.

productsAndServices.description: A B2B platform that enables hotels and travel brands to publish, sell, book, and manage in-destination experiences across guest-facing and staff channels.
productsAndServices.name: Turneo Experiences Platform

productsAndServices.description: AI tools that assist hotel teams with experience marketing, recommendations, communications, itinerary creation, and operational tasks.

productsAndServices.description: A branded, embeddable storefront that lets hotel guests browse and book in-house and local experiences through websites, apps, messaging, and APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Experience Store and Booking Engine

productsAndServices.description: A centralized system for configuring experiences, pricing, schedules, capacity, resources, properties, partners, commissions, payouts, and performance reports.
productsAndServices.name: Experience Management System

productsAndServices.description: A staff-facing booking tool for checking availability, making or changing reservations, charging rooms or cards, sending payment links, and creating guest itineraries.
productsAndServices.name: Concierge Booking System

productsAndServices.description: Operational support for coordinating experience partners and assisting guests with experience-related bookings and service requests.
productsAndServices.name: Partner and Guest Support Services

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,244,518, or 72.18% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,550,396 to $12,672,417, a 2.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 80 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Viator, GetYourGuide, Xola.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
